name: BSSRDF Approximation with Dipole and Single Scattering
aliases: BSSRDF Model with Dipole Diffusion Approximation
BSSRDF Rendering with Dipole Diffusion and Single Scattering
Practical Model for Subsurface Light Transport
summary: This method approximates subsurface light transport by combining a dipole diffusion model for multiple scattering with a single-scattering term to efficiently render translucent materials.
